description.en: User-defined agents with automatic routing, model failover, and squad orchestration for DeepSeek Harness. Ships six model tools (agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert), three built-in squads (dev-pipeline serial, debug-squad three-way parallel, review-squad two-way parallel), a native right-tab main panel (Overview / Agents / Squads / History), a floating action ball, and a / trigger Agent menu. No built-in agents — create your own via the panel, import them from skills, or upsert them programmatically without restarting. Subagent lifecycle events are wired for real outcome tracking; dispatches.jsonl rotates at 2000 lines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用户自定义 agent + 自动路由 + 小队编排插件。提供六个模型工具（agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert），三个内置小队（dev-pipeline 串行 / debug-squad 三路并行 / review-squad 双路并行），原生右 tab「Agent 调度」主面板（总览 / Agent / 小队 / 历史），悬浮活动球，`/` 触发器 Agent 候选菜单。不含内置 agent——可通过面板自建、从 skill 导入，或用 agent_upsert 工具免重启增改。订阅 subagent/end 事件补全真实结局，决策日志 2000 行自动轮转。
